nodes.label: Regulatory sensitivity and ESRA age rating
nodes.norm_label: regulatory sensitivity and esra age rating
nodes.rationale: UI avoids gambling cues (no «شرط», no pot imagery; prize/entry wording).

nodes.label: Capacitor Poolakey plugins (capacitor-poolakey, cordova-plugin-android-iab)
nodes.rationale: Unsure they work with Capacitor 8; fallback is ~100-line native plugin around Poolakey and Myket billing.

nodes.label: Card-game sensitivity (Wikishia, store policy unknown)
nodes.rationale: Most Shia jurists reportedly consider playing cards impermissible; Bazaar/Myket content policy not found; action: read publisher policies before submitting.

nodes.label: ESRA/ERSA age rating
nodes.rationale: Criteria include gambling; so no real-money stakes, no cash-out, no betting-style UI; fees framed as arena entry.

nodes.label: Least-sure risks list
nodes.rationale: Store policy, Capacitor 8 plugin compatibility, rating/registration duties, tooling reachability, third-party iOS store reliability.

nodes.label: Third-party iOS stores (SibApp, Anardoni)
nodes.rationale: Single-source claim; reliability, terms and certificate revocation risk unknown.

nodes.label: Installable PWA as iOS channel
nodes.rationale: Official App Store release not realistic for Iran users, so the web build is a first-class product, not a demo.

nodes.label: Persistence (localStorage profile.v1 / match.v1)
nodes.rationale: localStorage enough for data size; v2 SQLite via Capacitor and save export/import since OS may clear WebView storage. RNG seed/move log not yet stored.

nodes.label: Data safety (local only, erase all data, no analytics)
nodes.norm_label: data safety (local only, erase all data, no analytics)

nodes.label: Replays and shareable highlights (v2, needs move log)
nodes.norm_label: replays and shareable highlights (v2, needs move log)

nodes.label: Hash-chained ledger tamper model
nodes.rationale: SHA-256 chained ledger; mismatch rolls back to last valid entry. Key ships in bundle so only stops casual edits; accepted because nothing has cash value; server verification with online play.

nodes.label: Cheating surface (editable offline coins)
nodes.rationale: Risk is cosmetic because currencies have no cash value; real protection comes with server verification.

nodes.label: Known gaps
nodes.rationale: No real SDKs, no device builds or profiling, tutorial is slides, only e2e smoke UI tests.

nodes.label: Low-end Android constraint (2 GB, Android 7-10)
nodes.rationale: Web build ~94 KB gzip JS plus ~27 KB per font weight; no video/3D; not profiled on real device.

nodes.label: Wikipedia: Pasur (card game)
nodes.rationale: Disagrees with other sources on play direction (clockwise) and 3p club tie scoring.

nodes.label: Rule calls to overrule (8 decisions)
nodes.rationale: Sur Sarbaz=10; clubs>=7; forced capture; opening Jack replaced; match to 62 with 50-point cap; counter-clockwise; last turn = last round; one capture group. All toggles or constants in RulesConfig.

nodes.label: R10/R11/R13 One capture group per play; drop if no capture
nodes.norm_label: r10/r11/r13 one capture group per play; drop if no capture
nodes.rationale: No source allows several disjoint groups in one play.

nodes.label: R12 Capture compulsory for a capturing card (mustCapture)
nodes.norm_label: r12 capture compulsory for a capturing card (mustcapture)
nodes.rationale: Pagat/Wikipedia/Jahanshiri: a capturable card cannot be dropped; the brief's 'not forced' is satisfied at card-choice level.

nodes.label: R15 Sur (floor cleared, 5 points)
nodes.rationale: No Sur if capturer is a Jack or in last round of deal; noSurInLastRound default true (Pagat).

nodes.label: R16 50-point Sur cap
nodes.rationale: Pagat and Jahanshiri; docx says better to agree. Pagat's second-Sur-cancels-Sur variant not implemented in v1.

nodes.label: R17 Sur Sarbaz (lone Jack capture, 10 points)
nodes.norm_label: r17 sur sarbaz (lone jack capture, 10 points)
nodes.rationale: Exists only in the docx; docx says 10 in definition and 5 in score list; 10 chosen as rarer event (Wikipedia notes some play Sur = 10).

nodes.label: R18 Last capturer takes leftover floor cards
nodes.norm_label: r18 last capturer takes leftover floor cards

nodes.label: R19 Clubs scoring (>=7, 3p tie gives third)
nodes.norm_label: r19 clubs scoring (>=7, 3p tie gives third)
nodes.rationale: Docx 'more than seven' would leave a 7-6 split of 13 clubs unawarded, contradicting 20 points per deal; Pagat/Jahanshiri say 7 or more. 3p tie: docx, Pagat, Jahanshiri give third player the 7; Wikipedia says nobody.

nodes.label: R20 Base points total 20 per deal
nodes.norm_label: r20 base points total 20 per deal

nodes.label: R21 Match target 62 (or 100 / single deal)
nodes.rationale: 62 agreed by Pagat, Wikipedia, Jahanshiri; 100 common variant; ties continue.

nodes.label: R4 Play direction counter-clockwise
nodes.rationale: Pagat and Jahanshiri say counter-clockwise, Wikipedia says clockwise (conflict); natural in RTL UI where turn passes to the right.

nodes.label: R5 Opening floor Jack replace/redeal
nodes.rationale: All three sources agree; overrides the brief's 'no redeal' default.

nodes.label: R8 Queen/King capture same rank only
nodes.norm_label: r8 queen/king capture same rank only

nodes.label: R9 Jack captures all except Queens/Kings
nodes.norm_label: r9 jack captures all except queens/kings

nodes.label: AdProvider / ads policy (Home and Result only, mock)
nodes.norm_label: adprovider / ads policy (home and result only, mock)
nodes.rationale: User-initiated only, never mid-hand; adapter slot for Tapsell/Adivery; +60 Shahi, 2-min cooldown, 8/day.

nodes.label: Arena system (10 arenas)
nodes.rationale: Each arena has landmark scene, 3 times of day, table colours, ambient bed, bot pool, entry fee, trophy gate. Trophies are the only gate; levelling is a reward channel. Ladder: Persepolis, Si-o-se-pol, Naqsh-e Jahan, Yazd, Chehel Sotoun, Eram Garden, Golestan Palace, Tabriz Bazaar, Chogha Zanbil, Arg-e Bam.

nodes.label: Gohar (گوهر) premium currency
nodes.rationale: Cosmetics only; can never be staked or used for fees so real money cannot flow into match stakes. Packs 20/60/150 priced at placeholder Toman 29k/79k/169k. 'Toman' avoided as game currency.

nodes.label: Shahi (شاهی) soft currency
nodes.rationale: Sources: prizes, daily login, challenges, rewarded video, relief gift. Sinks: arena fees and rake. Never purchasable directly, never cashable.

nodes.label: Trophy/XP progression (+25/-12, level-up 2 Gohar)
nodes.rationale: Clash-style: arenas stay unlocked unless trophies fall below gate.

nodes.label: v2 arena candidates (Khaju Bridge, Hasht Behesht, Shushtar mills, Abyaneh, Falak-ol-Aflak)
nodes.norm_label: v2 arena candidates (khaju bridge, hasht behesht, shushtar mills, abyaneh, falak-ol-aflak)
nodes.rationale: Avoided: mosques, shrines, tombs.

nodes.label: Visual direction (indigo and gold, Vazirmatn, procedural sound)
nodes.norm_label: visual direction (indigo and gold, vazirmatn, procedural sound)
nodes.rationale: Lapis and gold of Persian tilework; claude-design and ui-ux-pro-max skills not installed so designed by hand.

nodes.label: Accessibility (large-index deck, hints, colour-blind deck v2)
nodes.norm_label: accessibility (large-index deck, hints, colour-blind deck v2)

nodes.label: Bots at 3 levels (medium beats easy 75%, hard beats medium 65%)
nodes.norm_label: bots at 3 levels (medium beats easy 75%, hard beats medium 65%)

nodes.label: Decks, card backs, tables, avatar creator, Ganjifeh deck
nodes.norm_label: decks, card backs, tables, avatar creator, ganjifeh deck
nodes.rationale: 3 decks incl. large-index accessibility deck; layered avatar creator and genuinely Ganjifeh-style illustrated deck are v2.

nodes.label: Persian-first features (RTL, Vazirmatn, Jalali, procedural sound)
nodes.norm_label: persian-first features (rtl, vazirmatn, jalali, procedural sound)
nodes.rationale: No Google Fonts; no audio files; recorded santur/daf and seasonal skins (Nowruz, Yalda, Mehregan) in v2.

nodes.label: Chaharbarg (Pasur) offline Persian card game
nodes.rationale: Offline-first, Persian first, English second; Android/iOS via web/PWA + Capacitor; play vs bots or pass-and-play in 10 arenas on Iranian historical sites.

nodes.label: Pot and 10% rake sink
nodes.rationale: Every player pays fee; 2p winner gets 1.8x; draw refunds; 10% rake is the currency sink.

nodes.label: Principles and anti-goals
nodes.rationale: Persian first, offline first, no real-money gambling or cash-out, no dark patterns (no energy timers, no mid-hand ads, no loot boxes, daily ad cap, relief gift), original art only, engine separate from UI.

nodes.label: Economy honesty (net -10% of fee for 50% player)
nodes.norm_label: economy honesty (net -10% of fee for 50% player)
nodes.rationale: Income comes from daily login, challenges and ads; needs playtest tuning.

nodes.label: Currency naming (Shahi, Gohar, Toman)
nodes.rationale: Shahi is a historical coin and colloquial small sum, used only as game-point name; Toman only for real prices.

nodes.label: Secular heritage site selection
nodes.rationale: Partly disagrees with brief: Naqsh-e Jahan and Yazd contain mosques so only arcades/Ali Qapu and wind-towers shown; Chogha Zanbil kept as 3,000-year-old ruin.

nodes.label: Flutter (option)
nodes.rationale: For: flutter_poolakey, iran_iap, tapsell_plus, perf. Against: Dart engine can't run on Node server, pub.dev/Gradle reachability from Iran unverified, SDKs absent, weak iOS PWA story.

nodes.label: React Native (option)
nodes.rationale: Official react-native-poolakey and TS engine reuse, but heavier toolchain and no PWA reuse.

nodes.label: StoreProvider and idempotent grantPurchase
nodes.rationale: Idempotent so restore/replay never double-grants; real build must verify store RSA signature (Poolakey/Myket) first.

nodes.label: Unity (option)
nodes.rationale: Tapsell and Myket Unity SDKs exist but heavy APK, overkill for 2D card game, no web channel.

nodes.label: Real Tapsell/Adivery and Bazaar/Myket adapters (not built)
nodes.norm_label: real tapsell/adivery and bazaar/myket adapters (not built)
nodes.rationale: Needs SDK accounts; mock providers only in v1.

nodes.label: Cafe Bazaar
nodes.rationale: Primary Android channel; billing SDK Poolakey.

nodes.label: GitHub availability in Iran (2019 restriction, 2021 licence)
nodes.norm_label: github availability in iran (2019 restriction, 2021 licence)

nodes.label: Myket
nodes.rationale: SDKs for Unity, Cordova, Flutter, .NET; says to validate purchase signatures server-side; no Capacitor plugin found.

nodes.label: Iranian payments (Shaparak PSPs, Zarinpal, Enamad)
nodes.rationale: Store billing simplest for Android; Zarinpal needed for web/PWA with registered business; virtual-currency licensing unverified; ask a local lawyer.

nodes.label: Framework decision (most consequential call)
nodes.rationale: Capacitor chosen for TS engine reuse on a Node server, web build doubling as iOS PWA channel, tiny bundle, fast testing without SDK. Switch cost: engine+economy port as-is to React Native; Flutter needs Dart rewrite (~1k lines plus tests).

nodes.label: Google services unavailable (Play, Firebase, FCM, AdMob, Google Fonts)
nodes.norm_label: google services unavailable (play, firebase, fcm, admob, google fonts)
nodes.rationale: Unverified opinion-piece claim that Google bans Iranian developers; treated as unavailable; app avoids all of them.

nodes.label: Build tooling reachability from Iran (npm, Maven, pub.dev)
nodes.norm_label: build tooling reachability from iran (npm, maven, pub.dev)
nodes.rationale: Unverified; mitigation: small dependency set, no runtime network, committed lockfile, vendored Gradle caches or mirror.

nodes.label: Capacitor + React/TS (chosen)
nodes.rationale: Against: billing/ad plugins for Bazaar/Myket/Tapsell are community/bridge work; WebView perf on very old phones.

nodes.label: Offline architecture (engine + mobile + Capacitor)
nodes.rationale: Engine state is plain JSON with pure validated play()/matchPlay(), so a server can run it authoritatively; online later = send Move and replay from seed. No network calls; service worker caches shell.

nodes.label: Online play, seasons, leaderboards (later, needs server)
nodes.norm_label: online play, seasons, leaderboards (later, needs server)
nodes.rationale: Engine is server-ready.

nodes.label: Built slices 1-5 (rules spec, engine, economy, app, native shell)
nodes.norm_label: built slices 1-5 (rules spec, engine, economy, app, native shell)
nodes.rationale: Engine verified by 36 vitest tests incl. random self-play; economy by 20 tests; Android project generated but not built (no JDK/SDK).

nodes.label: Ponytail process (minimal dependencies)
nodes.rationale: No state library, router or CSS framework; strings colocated via tr(fa, en); ponytail comments mark known ceilings.
